'''JG-1''', also known as the '''Junk Giant''', was a [[monster droid]] created by [[Cyrus Vuundir|Taborr Val Dorn]] and his [[Taborr's gang|gang]]. She was later adopted by the [[Chadra-Fan]] junk keeper [[Marlaa Jinara]] to work in [[Marlaa Jinara's junkyard|her junkyard]].<ref name="The Junk Giant" /> JG-1 had a special system of rechargeable [[power cell]]s to energize her massive frame. One of these cells was stolen by rogue [[droidsmith]] [[Rek Minuu]] to power his custom droid [[Apexx]].<ref name="Apexx Awakens" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
JG-1, albeit unidentified, first appeared in the picture book ''[[Young Jedi Adventures: Jedi Training]]'',<ref name="Jedi Training">''[[Young Jedi Adventures: Jedi Training]]''</ref> which was authored by [[Caitlin Kennedy]] and published by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] on [[May 2]], [[2023]].<ref name="Book Release">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/726074/star-wars-young-jedi-adventures-jedi-training-by-caitlin--kennedy|text=Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures: Jedi Training}}</ref> The droid was later identified in "[[The Junk Giant]]," the second part of the [[Get Well Nubs / The Junk Giant|third episode]] of the [[Disney+]] and [[Disney Junior]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]'',<ref name="The Junk Giant" /> which aired on [[May 4]], 2023.<ref name="D23 May">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-may-2023|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in May 2023}}</ref>

Despite JG-1's first appearance, the droid was an original character created and developed for the animated series. During the character's conception, JG-1 was designed by [[Andy Bialk]] and [[Amy Beth Christenson]], though they landed and finalized with the latter's design which passed to Gabriel Lopez who modeled the droid before texture work can be done by ICON Creative Studio.<ref name="Concept">{{Instagram|username=andybialk|url=p/DBC49nUSl0X|name=[[Andy Bialk]]|date=2024-10-13|quote=🤖JG-1🤖 rough concepts & turn (loving the final design by @artbyabc ) s1 ep3 “The Junk Giant” @starwars 💫Young Jedi Adventures💫|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/ixKbA|archivefile=File:JG1ConceptDesign-AndyBialk-IG.png}}</ref><ref>{{ArtStation|url=artwork/Xg2rgl|username=gabelopez|name=[[Gabriel Lopez]]|text=Star Wars Young Jedi Adventures – Droids 2}}</ref>
